name: Panel From Brep
description: Creates a Panel from a Brep. Automatically detects the two parallel faces as top and bottom.

inputParameters.name: brep
inputParameters.description: Referenced brep in the active Rhino document.

inputParameters.name: orientation
inputParameters.description: (Optional) Direction of the panel's local y-axis, e.g. up for a wall. Unset: derived from the outline.

inputParameters.name: features
inputParameters.description: (Optional) Panel feature definitions from the Panel Opening, MEP Penetration, Niche or Linear Service components. Definitions that do not lie on this panel are skipped, so the same list can go to every panel.

inputParameters.name: updateRefObj
inputParameters.description: (optional) If True, attributes in the referenced object will be updated.
